17.title: 17. Defensive Security and Blue Team Operations

G1.title: G1 — Requirements Approval Gate
G1.approval_authority: Product Owner (plus the Security Authority for the REQ-S and Data Owner for the REQ-P)

G2.title: G2 — Architecture Approval Gate
G2.entry: G1 passed. P02-T01..T06, T08 are VERIFIED.

G3.title: G3 — Threat Modeling Gate
G3.entry: The architecture draft with DFDs is available. P02-T07 is complete.

G4.title: G4 — Secure Design Gate
G4.entry: G2 and G3 passed. The API contracts, the data model, the auth design, and the UX flows for the increment are drafted.

G5.title: G5 — Code Review Gate (per change)
G5.entry: A PR is open with the template completed, and CI is green.
G5.approval_authority: Technical Reviewer (plus the Security Engineer for the sensitive paths)

G6.title: G6 — Testing Gate
G6.entry: The release candidate is built from the main. All the P07 tasks are VERIFIED.

G7.title: G7 — Security Validation Gate
G7.entry: G3 passed. The build is deployed to the test environment. P06-T02..T13 are VERIFIED.

G8.title: G8 — Deployment Readiness Gate
G8.entry: G6 and G7 passed (or in progress for the same digest). P08 tasks are VERIFIED.

G9.title: G9 — Production Release Gate
G9.entry: G6, G7, and G8 are valid for the same digest. The release readiness checklist is complete.

tasks.name: Establish project charter and authority
tasks.validation: Humans have signed. Every gate has a named approver. The process profile is recorded and deviations require an approved ADR.

tasks.name: Establish authorized environments and access
tasks.validation: No shared or long-lived credentials. Reviewed by Security.

tasks.name: Initialize project ledger
tasks.validation: Files exist and are version controlled; `RESTRICTED/VULNS.md` is access-restricted; `graphify-out/` exists and is current when Graphify is configured.

tasks.name: Establish test and offensive-security authorization baseline
tasks.validation: Security Authority signature.

tasks.name: Discovery and problem identification
tasks.outputs: Problem Statement, KPI list, Open Questions Log
tasks.validation: Each KPI is measurable (baseline, target, method). Blocking questions are answered or turned into logged assumptions.

tasks.name: Stakeholder analysis
tasks.validation: Every gate approver is present. Every user class maps to at least one persona.

tasks.name: Elicit business, functional, and non-functional requirements
tasks.validation: No requirement is ambiguous (no "fast", "secure", "user-friendly" without metrics). Each is atomic, testable, and uniquely identified.

tasks.name: User stories, use cases, acceptance criteria
tasks.outputs: Story Backlog, Use Case Specs, Acceptance Criteria
tasks.validation: Each story has ≥ 1 positive and ≥ 1 negative criterion. Each criterion is automatable or has a documented manual procedure.

tasks.name: Constraints, assumptions, dependencies, scope boundaries
tasks.outputs: Constraints and Assumptions Register, Scope Statement
tasks.validation: Out-of-scope is explicit. Each assumption has an owner and expiry.

tasks.name: Feasibility and technical research
tasks.outputs: Feasibility Report, Spike Results, Technology Shortlist
tasks.validation: Every claim has a source or an experiment. No technology is chosen by popularity alone.

tasks.name: Risk identification
tasks.validation: Top risks have owners and mitigations. High risks are reported to the human sponsor.

tasks.name: Initial security and privacy requirements
tasks.outputs: Security and Privacy Requirements (REQ-S, REQ-P), Data Inventory, ASVS target level
tasks.validation: Each REQ-S is testable. ASVS level is justified. Data inventory has an owner for each data class.

tasks.name: Compile Requirements Specification and Project Definition; seed the RTM
tasks.outputs: Requirements Specification, Project Definition, RTM v0
tasks.validation: Technical Reviewer completes the consistency check (no conflicting requirements, no orphan stories, and glossary defined).

tasks.name: System decomposition and architectural style selection
tasks.validation: ADR lists ≥ 2 alternatives and trade-offs tied to NFRs.

tasks.name: Component architecture, service boundaries, DDD (where appropriate)
tasks.outputs: Component diagram (C4 Level 2–3), Context Map, Module Interface Specs
tasks.validation: Dependency graph has no cycles. Each module has a single clear responsibility.

tasks.name: Data flow, system interaction, and API architecture
tasks.outputs: DFD set, API Architecture, Contract drafts
tasks.validation: Every flow is traced to a requirement. Contracts validate with a linter.

tasks.name: Database, caching, messaging, and integration architecture
tasks.outputs: Data Architecture, Messaging Design, Integration Design
tasks.validation: Each data store has an owner and a failure behavior. Each integration has a failure-mode analysis.

tasks.name: Infrastructure, scalability, availability, failure handling, DR
tasks.outputs: Infrastructure Architecture, FMEA, DR Plan outline
tasks.validation: RTO and RPO are traceable to REQ-N. Every single point of failure is either removed or explicitly accepted by a human.

tasks.name: Security architecture
tasks.validation: Every REQ-S is mapped to ≥ 1 control. Critical assets have ≥ 2 independent controls.

tasks.name: Threat modeling and abuse-case analysis
tasks.outputs: Threat Model (`THR-###`), Attack Surface Inventory, Residual Risk Register
tasks.validation: All trust-boundary crossings have threats considered. Each High/Critical threat has a mitigation with a verification test ID.

tasks.name: Architecture Decision Records
tasks.validation: Reviewer confirms each is justified by an NFR or constraint.

tasks.name: Compile the Architecture Specification, then pass G2, G3, and G4 (design portion)
tasks.validation: See gate criteria G2, G3, G4.

tasks.name: User research, information architecture
tasks.validation: Each persona goal maps to a path in the IA.

tasks.name: User flows, wireframes, prototypes
tasks.validation: Every acceptance criterion in P01 has a screen and state.

tasks.name: Design system and accessibility baseline
tasks.validation: Automated a11y checks pass. Manual keyboard and screen-reader check done on key flows.

tasks.name: Frontend architecture and scaffolding
tasks.validation: Build is reproducible. Lint, type-check, and format gates are enforced in CI.

tasks.name: Component-driven implementation
tasks.validation: Each component has a11y and interaction tests.

tasks.name: Forms, validation, API integration, error and loading states
tasks.validation: Contract tests against the mock server and the real API. All error codes are handled.

tasks.name: Frontend security hardening
tasks.validation: Security checklist (§19.3) complete.

tasks.name: Performance and compatibility
tasks.validation: Budgets are met in CI. Compat tests are green on the matrix.

tasks.name: Frontend verification and handoff
tasks.validation: Gate G5 for each change. Part of G6.

tasks.name: Runtime and framework selection, project scaffold
tasks.validation: Clean build. Architecture fitness test passes.

tasks.name: Contract-first API design and versioning
tasks.validation: Contract is linted. Frontend generates a client from it.

tasks.name: Authentication and session management
tasks.validation: Negative tests: brute force, fixation, expired and tampered tokens, and enumeration.

tasks.name: Authorization (function-level and object-level)
tasks.validation: **AuthZ matrix test**: role × endpoint × object ownership, including cross-tenant. 100% of endpoints covered.

tasks.name: Business logic: services, repositories, domain rules
tasks.validation: Unit and property tests for invariants. Abuse-case tests from the threat model.

tasks.name: Input validation, serialization, error handling, logging
tasks.outputs: Validation layer, error handler, log schema
tasks.validation: Fuzz and negative tests. Log review shows no sensitive fields.

tasks.name: Background jobs, queues, event processing, third-party integrations
tasks.validation: Failure-injection tests. Webhook forgery tests.

tasks.name: Abuse and platform protections: rate limiting, SSRF, uploads, resource exhaustion
tasks.validation: Negative security tests pass.

tasks.name: Performance optimization and documentation
tasks.validation: NFR targets met in load tests (Phase 07). Docs are generated from the contract.

tasks.name: Backend verification and handoff
tasks.validation: G5 per change, then G6 and G7 contribution.

tasks.name: Database selection
tasks.validation: Scored matrix. Operational ownership defined.

tasks.name: Data modeling and ERD
tasks.validation: Each table has an owner and a classification. Each REQ-F data need is covered.

tasks.name: Schema implementation and migrations
tasks.validation: Apply-on-empty and apply-on-snapshot tests pass. Timing measured.

tasks.name: Indexing and query optimization
tasks.validation: Top queries meet latency targets at projected volume (load tested).

tasks.name: Transactions, concurrency, integrity
tasks.validation: Concurrency tests (parallel writes) demonstrate invariants.

tasks.name: Database security
tasks.validation: DB security checklist complete.

tasks.name: Backup, recovery, replication, partitioning
tasks.outputs: Backup and DR runbook, restore test report
tasks.validation: A successful restore with measured RTO. Data integrity checks after restore.

tasks.name: Retention, deletion, data lifecycle
tasks.validation: A deletion test proves data removal across stores and caches.

tasks.name: Caching strategy and data verification
tasks.validation: Cache poisoning and cross-tenant tests pass.

tasks.name: Security requirements and architecture review (continuous)
tasks.validation: No design change without a threat-model delta check.

tasks.name: Automated security controls in CI (SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, container)
tasks.validation: Intentional seeded-vulnerability test proves the tools detect a known issue (verifies the tool works).

tasks.name: Security control implementation verification
tasks.validation: 100% of REQ-S verified or have an accepted risk.

tasks.name: Authorization and RoE
tasks.validation: Human signature. Scope allowlist is configured in the tooling (tools technically restricted to in-scope targets).

tasks.name: Reconnaissance, asset discovery, enumeration
tasks.outputs: Asset and endpoint inventory, discrepancy list
tasks.validation: Every discovered asset is in scope or flagged and reported (not tested).

tasks.name: Vulnerability assessment
tasks.validation: Each finding has evidence, CWE, and reproduction steps, or is marked "unconfirmed".

tasks.name: Web, API, authentication, and authorization testing
tasks.validation: Each ASVS control in scope is marked pass, fail, or not applicable (with reasons).

tasks.name: Network, infrastructure, and configuration assessment
tasks.validation: Benchmark deviations are documented with risk acceptance or remediation.

tasks.name: Controlled exploitation, privilege escalation, and post-exploitation impact assessment (where authorized)
tasks.validation: Evidence shows reproducibility and the minimal-impact method. All artifacts are cleaned up and the system is restored.

tasks.name: Reporting and remediation verification
tasks.outputs: Security Assessment Report, Vulnerability Register, Remediation Plan
tasks.validation: Every finding is Closed-Verified, Accepted-Risk (signed), or scheduled with an owner and date.

tasks.name: Security monitoring, logging, detection engineering
tasks.validation: Each detection is **tested** (alert fires). Alert routing verified.

tasks.name: Incident response readiness
tasks.validation: Contacts verified. Containment actions executable in the runbook.

tasks.name: Hardening, access management, vulnerability management, auditing
tasks.outputs: Hardening baselines, access review records, audit report
tasks.validation: Automated compliance checks (for example benchmark scans) pass or have signed exceptions.

tasks.name: Test strategy and plan
tasks.validation: Every REQ has ≥ 1 TC. Every High risk has targeted tests.

tasks.name: Unit and component tests
tasks.validation: Coverage thresholds (Part 11). Mutation testing on critical modules where feasible.

tasks.name: Integration, API, and contract tests
tasks.validation: Contract conformance is 100%.

tasks.name: End-to-end and acceptance tests
tasks.validation: Critical journeys pass on the supported browser matrix.

tasks.name: Non-functional tests: performance, load, stress, soak, reliability
tasks.validation: NFR thresholds met. Failure behavior matches the design (graceful degradation).

tasks.name: Compatibility and accessibility tests
tasks.validation: 0 critical or serious a11y issues.

tasks.name: Security tests (with P06)
tasks.validation: Every fixed vulnerability has a regression test.

tasks.name: Regression management, coverage analysis, defect tracking
tasks.validation: No S1 or S2 open. Flaky rate under the threshold.

tasks.name: Test report and G6 submission
tasks.validation: Satisfies G6 criteria.

tasks.name: Git workflow, branching, PRs, review
tasks.validation: Branch protection verified by an API query.

tasks.name: CI pipeline
tasks.validation: A clean-clone build is reproducible.

tasks.name: Infrastructure as Code
tasks.validation: `plan` shows no unexpected diff. IaC scan has no High findings.

tasks.name: Containerization and orchestration (where justified)
tasks.validation: Image scan has no unresolved High or Critical. Benchmark scan passes.

tasks.name: Environments, configuration, secrets
tasks.validation: No secret in the repo or images (scan). Production credentials are unavailable to dev and CI by default.

tasks.name: CD, deployment strategies, rollbacks
tasks.validation: Rollback is rehearsed in staging with measured time.

tasks.name: Supply chain security
tasks.validation: Deploy refuses an unsigned or unverified artifact (negative test).

tasks.name: DNS, TLS, reverse proxy, edge
tasks.validation: TLS scan grade acceptable. No dangling DNS.

tasks.name: Pipeline security and permissions
tasks.validation: A pipeline permission review is complete. A secret-exfiltration test from a fork PR fails as expected.

tasks.name: DR and migration deployment
tasks.validation: DR drill passes against RTO and RPO.

tasks.name: Pipeline verification and G8 submission
tasks.validation: Satisfies G8 criteria.

tasks.name: Pre-deployment verification
tasks.validation: The digest match is recorded.

tasks.name: Release readiness assessment
tasks.validation: All items green or waived by an authority.

tasks.name: Security approval
tasks.validation: Signed approval.

tasks.name: Production configuration and migration validation
tasks.validation: Reviewer confirms the diff.

tasks.name: Deployment execution (human-approved, NN-04)
tasks.validation: The pipeline log shows the approved run ID and approver.

tasks.name: Smoke tests and health checks
tasks.validation: All pass. Otherwise execute P09-T07.

tasks.name: Rollback decision (if triggered)
tasks.validation: Verified restore of the prior state, plus a post-rollback smoke test.

tasks.name: Release documentation and change management
tasks.validation: G9 and G10 recorded.

tasks.name: Observability foundation
tasks.validation: Trace of a sample request spans all components.

tasks.name: SLOs, alerting, availability and performance monitoring
tasks.validation: An alert-fire test for each critical alert.

tasks.name: Security event monitoring
tasks.validation: Detection coverage mapped to ATT&CK. Triage SLA met.

tasks.name: Vulnerability, dependency, and patch management
tasks.validation: SLA compliance rate is reported monthly.

tasks.name: Backup verification and disaster recovery testing
tasks.validation: Measured values meet the targets, or a remediation plan exists.

tasks.name: Incident management
tasks.validation: Every Sev1 and Sev2 has a PIR within 5 business days.

tasks.name: Capacity planning and cost
tasks.validation: Headroom policy met (for example peak utilization below 70%).

tasks.name: Technical debt management
tasks.validation: Debt trend reported each cycle.

tasks.name: Operational documentation
tasks.validation: A new agent or human can execute a runbook without extra help (verified by a dry run).

tasks.name: Engineering retrospectives
tasks.validation: Previous actions are reviewed for closure.

tasks.name: Architecture review
tasks.validation: Fitness functions pass. Stale ADRs are marked superseded.

tasks.name: Security reassessment
tasks.validation: Delta findings are tracked in the Vulnerability Register.

tasks.name: Performance and scalability optimization
tasks.validation: A measured improvement, with no regression elsewhere.

tasks.name: Refactoring and debt reduction
tasks.validation: Tests stay green, and the complexity metrics improve.

tasks.name: Dependency lifecycle and technology evaluation
tasks.validation: Each adoption has an ADR.

tasks.name: Documentation updates and lessons learned
tasks.validation: Docs-as-code checks pass.

tasks.name: Future development planning
tasks.validation: Approved by the Product Owner.
